xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4933: Agent MCP and bots (W-INJ2): Codex: [mcp_servers.overdeck]

narratives.Problem: Codex agents and conversations that Overdeck launches never get the overdeck MCP server: every Codex launch path (work agents, role runs, recovery, message-fallback and planning relaunches through getCodexLauncherFields, and conversations through a direct initCodexHome call) writes config.toml without an [mcp_servers.overdeck] table. Planning probes on Codex CLI 0.159.0 also showed that a plain table is not enough: Overdeck's tools carry no read-only annotations, so every model-initiated call fails under approval_policy never ('MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never') and would prompt an unattended agent under on-request.
narratives.Proposal: Add prepareCodexOverdeckMcp(owner) to src/lib/mcp/agent-injection.ts, sharing one private mint helper with prepareClaudeOverdeckMcp; it returns { overdeck: overdeckStdioServer(tokenFile) + defaultToolsApprovalMode 'approve' } or {} and never throws. Flip CODEX_CAPABILITIES.overdeckMcp to true. Give CodexMcpServerDef an optional defaultToolsApprovalMode that initCodexHome validates and writes as default_tools_approval_mode. Give getCodexLauncherFields an optional sixth parameter (a server map merged after the role's servers) so it stays synchronous, and pass await prepareCodexOverdeckMcp(...) at the five agent call sites. In spawnConversationSession, move the conversation row lookup above the harness branches and pass the conversation-owned map to initCodexHome. Update configuration/mcp.mdx, configuration/harnesses.mdx (CP-2 result) and the epic PRD revision note. CP-2 passed in planning (config parse, app-server load and direct call, codex exec call with and without the approval key), so the -c command-line fallback is not built.
narratives.NonGoals:
- ACP and opencode injection (W-INJ3) and the MCP/CLI instructions blocks (W-INJ4)
- The legacy CodexRuntimeSync.spawnAgent codex exec path (src/lib/runtimes/codex.ts:653, used by cloister service-crash and session-rotation), src/lib/protocol-capture/record.ts, Fly launches, and the Claude-only planning continuation route (routes/misc/planning.ts)
- Approval modes for role-declared MCP servers such as playwright
- tool_timeout_sec or startup_timeout_sec on the overdeck table
- A Codex CLI version floor or launch preflight
- The -c mcp_servers.overdeck.* command-line fallback for app-server mode
- Making getCodexLauncherFields or initCodexHome async
- Any change to the Claude Code JSON entry written by writeClaudeOverdeckMcpConfig
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Mint at each call site and pass the server map into getCodexLauncherFields as an optional sixth parameter, keeping it synchronous.
autoDecisions.rationale: The mint must precede initCodexHome; keeping the function synchronous leaves runtime-command-effort.test.ts and role-mcp-parser.test.ts unchanged and adds no runtime-command.ts -> agent-injection.ts import edge.

autoDecisions.summary: Write default_tools_approval_mode = "approve" on the overdeck table only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probe: without it every model-initiated call fails under never and prompts under on-request. It is the Codex counterpart of W-INJ1's --allowedTools=mcp__overdeck; the token's scopes and route-scopes.ts still bound every call.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not build the epic's -c command-line fallback for app-server mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: The app-server probe loaded [mcp_servers.overdeck] from CODEX_HOME/config.toml, listed the scope-filtered tools and answered list_conversations.

autoDecisions.summary: Also wire the recovery, message-fallback and planning Codex launches.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic text named only work agents, role runs and conversations; without these a relaunched Codex agent loses its tools. Each is one argument on an existing line.

autoDecisions.summary: Flip CODEX_CAPABILITIES.overdeckMcp in the helper item, not a separate item.
autoDecisions.rationale: The helper's tests need it, and no runtime path reads the capability for Codex until the call sites pass the map; W-INJ4 is not merged.

autoDecisions.summary: Record CP-2 from the planning probes and leave the agent-level live check to after deploy.
autoDecisions.rationale: The branch code only runs in a dashboard after merge and pan reload; the unit tests pin the exact TOML the probes validated.
